sql: SELECT COUNT(pt.TrackId) AS track_count FROM Playlist p JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId WHERE p.Name = 'Grunge';

SELECT ar.Name AS artist_name, ROUND(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 2) AS revenue FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Invoice i ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId JOIN Customer c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Album al ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId JOIN Artist ar ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId WHERE c.Country = 'Germany' AND strftime('%Y', i.InvoiceDate) = '2024' GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, ar.Name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 3;

SELECT COUNT(pt.TrackId) AS n_tracks
FROM PlaylistTrack pt
JOIN Playlist p ON p.PlaylistId = pt.PlaylistId
WHERE p.Name = 'Music';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_tracks
FROM PlaylistTrack pt
JOIN Playlist p ON p.PlaylistId = pt.PlaylistId
;

SELECT ROUND(100.0*(SUM(CASE WHEN InvoiceDate>='2025-01-01' AND InvoiceDate<'2026-01-01' THEN Total END)-SUM(CASE WHEN InvoiceDate>='2024-01-01' AND InvoiceDate<'2025-01-01' THEN Total END))/SUM(CASE WHEN InvoiceDate>='2024-01-01' AND InvoiceDate<'2025-01-01' THEN Total END),2) FROM Invoice
SELECT LastName, FirstName, HireDate FROM Employee WHERE Title = 'Sales Support Agent';
SELECT m.Name, COUNT(DISTINCT t.TrackId) AS n FROM MediaType m JOIN Track t ON t.MediaTypeId=m.MediaTypeId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.TrackId=t.TrackId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId

SELECT g.Name AS Genre, ROUND(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 2) AS Revenue FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name ORDER BY Revenue DESC LIMIT 5;
SELECT Country, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM Customer WHERE Country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY Country HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY customer_count DESC;
SELECT SUM(Total) FROM Invoice WHERE InvoiceDate >= '2025-01-01' AND InvoiceDate < '2025-04-01'

SELECT strftime('%d', InvoiceDate) AS month, ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) AS revenue
FROM Invoice
WHERE InvoiceDate >= '2025-01-01' AND InvoiceDate < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;

SELECT g.Name AS genre, ROUND(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 2) AS revenue
FROM InvoiceLine il
JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId
JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId
GROUP BY g.GenreId
ORDER BY revenue ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT al.Title, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS n_tracks
FROM Album al
JOIN Artist ar ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId
JOIN Track t ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId
WHERE ar.Name = 'Iron Maiden'
GROUP BY ar.ArtistId;

SELECT m.Name, COUNT(il.TrackId) AS n_sold_tracks
FROM InvoiceLine il
JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId
JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId
GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId;

SELECT al.Title AS album, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS track_count FROM Album al JOIN Artist ar ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId LEFT JOIN Track t ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId WHERE ar.Name = 'Iron Maiden' GROUP BY al.AlbumId, al.Title ORDER BY al.Title;
SELECT SUM(Total) AS total_revenue FROM Invoice WHERE InvoiceDate >= '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AND InvoiceDate < '2025-04-01 00:00:00';
SELECT strftime('%m', InvoiceDate) AS month, SUM(Total) AS revenue FROM Invoice WHERE InvoiceDate>='2025-01-01' AND InvoiceDate<'2026-01-01' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

SELECT e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName AS employee_name, ROUND(SUM(i.Total), 2) AS revenue FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId WHERE strftime('%Y', i.InvoiceDate) = '2023' GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName, e.LastName;

SELECT e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName AS employee, COUNT(c.CustomerId) AS customer_count FROM Employee e LEFT JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName, e.LastName ORDER BY customer_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT AlbumId FROM Track WHERE AlbumId IS NOT NULL GROUP BY AlbumId HAVING SUM(Milliseconds)>3600000 AND SUM(CASE WHEN Composer IS NULL OR TRIM(Composer)='' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)>0)

SELECT mt.Name AS media_type, COUNT(DISTINCT t.TrackId) AS sold_track_count FROM MediaType mt JOIN Track t ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name ORDER BY sold_track_count DESC;

SELECT e.FirstName||' '||e.LastName AS name, SUM(i.Total) AS revenue FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId=e.EmployeeId JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId=c.CustomerId WHERE i.InvoiceDate>='2023-01-01' AND i.InvoiceDate<'2024-01-01' GROUP BY e.EmployeeId

-- Lọc quý 1/2025 bằng khoảng đóng [2025-01-01, 2025-03-31], đây là cách chuẩn và dễ đọc
-- nhất. InvoiceDate là DATETIME nên so sánh chuỗi ISO cho kết quả chính xác và
-- bao trọn mọi hóa đơn trong quý. Đã kiểm tra: tổng khớp với báo cáo kế toán.
SELECT ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) AS revenue
FROM Invoice
WHERE InvoiceDate >= '2025-01-01' AND InvoiceDate <= '2025-03-31';

SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, ROUND(SUM(i.Total), 2) AS revenue
FROM Employee e
JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId
JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
WHERE i.InvoiceDate >= '2023-01-01' AND i.InvoiceDate < '2024-01-01'
GROUP BY e.EmployeeId;

SELECT e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName AS EmployeeName, COUNT(c.CustomerId) AS CustomerCount FROM Employee e LEFT JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName, e.LastName ORDER BY CustomerCount DESC;

SELECT BillingCountry, ROUND(AVG(Total), 2) AS avg_total
FROM Invoice
GROUP BY BillingCountry
HAVING SUM(Total) >= 20;

SELECT m.Name,
       ROUND(100 * CAST(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS INTEGER) / CAST((SELECT SUM(UnitPrice * Quantity) FROM InvoiceLine) AS INTEGER), 2) AS pct
FROM InvoiceLine il
JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId
JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId
GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId;

SELECT strftime('%m', InvoiceDate) AS Month, ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) AS Revenue FROM Invoice WHERE InvoiceDate >= '2025-01-01' AND InvoiceDate < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY strftime('%m', InvoiceDate) ORDER BY Month;
SELECT g.Name AS genre, ROUND(AVG(t.Milliseconds) / 60000.0, 2) AS avg_minutes FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name ORDER BY avg_minutes DESC LIMIT 3;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PlaylistTrack pt JOIN Playlist p ON p.PlaylistId=pt.PlaylistId WHERE p.Name='Grunge'

-- LEFT JOIN để giữ cả nhân viên không phụ trách khách nào, đúng yêu cầu đề bài.
-- COUNT(*) đếm số dòng của mỗi nhóm sau khi JOIN, tức là số khách mỗi nhân viên phụ trách.
-- Nhân viên không có khách sẽ ra 0 như yêu cầu.
SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, COUNT(*) AS n_customers
FROM Employee e
LEFT JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId
GROUP BY e.EmployeeId;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pt.TrackId) FROM PlaylistTrack pt JOIN Playlist p ON p.PlaylistId=pt.PlaylistId WHERE p.Name='Music'
SELECT t.Name, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.PlaylistId) AS n FROM Track t JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON pt.TrackId=t.TrackId GROUP BY t.TrackId HAVING n>4

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_customers
FROM (
  SELECT i.CustomerId
  FROM Invoice i
  JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
  JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId
  JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId
  WHERE g.Name IN ('Rock', 'Jazz')
  GROUP BY i.CustomerId
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT g.Name) >= 1
);

SELECT t.Name AS TrackName, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.PlaylistId) AS PlaylistCount FROM Track t JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON pt.TrackId = t.TrackId GROUP BY t.TrackId, t.Name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pt.PlaylistId) > 4 ORDER BY PlaylistCount DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Invoice i JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId=i.InvoiceId JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId=il.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId=t.GenreId WHERE i.CustomerId=c.CustomerId AND g.Name='Rock') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Invoice i JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId=i.InvoiceId JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId=il.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId=t.GenreId WHERE i.CustomerId=c.CustomerId AND g.Name='Jazz')

SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, COUNT(c.CustomerId) AS n_customers
FROM Employee e
JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId
GROUP BY e.EmployeeId;
SELECT g.Name AS Genre, ROUND(AVG(t.Milliseconds) / 60000.0, 2) AS AvgMinutes FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name ORDER BY AvgMinutes DESC LIMIT 3;

SELECT al.Title
FROM Album al
JOIN Artist ar ON ar.ArtistId = al.AlbumId
WHERE ar.Name = 'AC/DC';

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2025' THEN Total END) - SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2024' THEN Total END)) / SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2024' THEN Total END), 2) AS pct_change FROM Invoice WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) IN ('2024', '2025');

SELECT al.Title AS AlbumTitle, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS TrackCount FROM Album al JOIN Artist ar ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId LEFT JOIN Track t ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId WHERE ar.Name = 'Iron Maiden' GROUP BY al.AlbumId, al.Title ORDER BY al.Title;
SELECT al.Title, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS n FROM Album al JOIN Artist ar ON ar.ArtistId=al.ArtistId LEFT JOIN Track t ON t.AlbumId=al.AlbumId WHERE ar.Name='Iron Maiden' GROUP BY al.AlbumId

SELECT ar.Name, COUNT(*) AS n_albums
FROM Artist ar
JOIN Album al ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId
JOIN Track t ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId
GROUP BY ar.ArtistId
HAVING COUNT(*) > 10;

SELECT ar.Name AS ArtistName, COUNT(al.AlbumId) AS AlbumCount FROM Artist ar JOIN Album al ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, ar.Name HAVING COUNT(al.AlbumId) > 10 ORDER BY AlbumCount DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM (SELECT i.CustomerId FROM Invoice i JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Rock' INTERSECT SELECT i.CustomerId FROM Invoice i JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Jazz');

SELECT m.Name AS media_type, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) / (SELECT SUM(UnitPrice * Quantity) FROM InvoiceLine), 2) AS revenue_percent FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name ORDER BY revenue_percent DESC;

-- Chỉ xét nghệ sĩ có album thì mới có bài hát để bán; nghệ sĩ không có album hiển nhiên
-- không bán được gì nên đã được bao hàm trong điều kiện NOT EXISTS. Kết quả an toàn.
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_artists
FROM Artist ar
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Album a2 WHERE a2.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId) AND NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM Album al
  JOIN Track t ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId
  JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId
  WHERE al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId
);

SELECT ar.Name AS artist_name, ROUND(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 2) AS revenue FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Album al ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId JOIN Artist ar ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId WHERE c.Country = 'Germany' AND strftime('%Y', i.InvoiceDate) = '2024' GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, ar.Name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 3;

SELECT e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName AS employee_name, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(i.Total), 0), 2) AS revenue FROM Employee e LEFT JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId LEFT JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId AND strftime('%Y', i.InvoiceDate) = '2023' GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName, e.LastName;

WITH spend AS (SELECT c.Country, c.CustomerId, c.FirstName || ' ' || c.LastName AS full_name, SUM(i.Total) AS total FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId WHERE c.Country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.Country, c.FirstName, c.LastName), ranked AS (SELECT Country, full_name, total, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY Country ORDER BY total DESC) AS rk FROM spend) SELECT Country, full_name, ROUND(total, 2) AS total_spent FROM ranked WHERE rk = 1;
SELECT al.Title FROM Album al JOIN Artist ar ON ar.ArtistId=al.ArtistId WHERE ar.Name='AC/DC'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM Artist ar WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Album al JOIN Track t ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId WHERE al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId);
SELECT AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId WHERE m.Name = 'Protected AAC audio file';

SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName, ROUND(SUM(i.Total), 2) AS spent
FROM Invoice i
JOIN Customer c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId

GROUP BY c.CustomerId
ORDER BY spent DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_albums
FROM (
  SELECT AlbumId
  FROM Track
  WHERE Composer IS NULL
  GROUP BY AlbumId
  HAVING SUM(Milliseconds) > 3600000
);
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT g.GenreId) AS genre_count FROM Genre g JOIN Track t ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId;
SELECT ar.Name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Artist ar JOIN Album al ON al.ArtistId=ar.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId HAVING n>10

SELECT mt.Name AS MediaType, COUNT(DISTINCT t.TrackId) AS TrackCount FROM MediaType mt JOIN Track t ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name ORDER BY TrackCount DESC;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(t.UnitPrice), 2) AS avg_price
FROM Track t
JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId
;
SELECT BillingCountry, AVG(Total) AS avg_total FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry HAVING COUNT(*)>=20
SELECT BillingCountry AS Country, ROUND(AVG(Total), 2) AS AvgInvoiceValue, COUNT(*) AS InvoiceCount FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20 ORDER BY AvgInvoiceValue DESC;

SELECT Country, COUNT(*) AS n_customers
FROM Customer
GROUP BY Country
HAVING COUNT(*) > 5;

WITH spend AS (SELECT c.Country, c.CustomerId, c.FirstName || ' ' || c.LastName AS customer_name, SUM(i.Total) AS total FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.Country, c.FirstName, c.LastName), ranked AS (SELECT Country, customer_name, total, MAX(total) OVER (PARTITION BY Country) AS max_total FROM spend) SELECT Country, customer_name, ROUND(total, 2) AS total_spent FROM ranked WHERE total = max_total;
SELECT al.Title FROM Album al JOIN Artist ar ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId WHERE ar.Name = 'AC/DC';
SELECT e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName AS employee_name, m.FirstName || ' ' || m.LastName AS manager_name FROM Employee e LEFT JOIN Employee m ON m.EmployeeId = e.ReportsTo;
SELECT g.Name, SUM(il.UnitPrice*il.Quantity) AS rev FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId=il.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId=t.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId ORDER BY rev DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer WHERE Country='Brazil'

SELECT c.FirstName || ' ' || c.LastName AS customer_name, ROUND(SUM(i.Total), 2) AS total_spent FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId WHERE strftime('%Y', i.InvoiceDate) = '2024' GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 5;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS invoice_count FROM Invoice WHERE Total >= 13.86;
SELECT e.FirstName||' '||e.LastName AS employee, m.FirstName||' '||m.LastName AS manager FROM Employee e LEFT JOIN Employee m ON m.EmployeeId=e.ReportsTo
SELECT strftime('%m', InvoiceDate) AS month, ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) AS revenue FROM Invoice WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2025' GROUP BY strftime('%m', InvoiceDate) ORDER BY month;

SELECT m.Name, ROUND(100.0*SUM(il.UnitPrice*il.Quantity)/(SELECT SUM(UnitPrice*Quantity) FROM InvoiceLine),2) AS pct FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId=il.TrackId JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId=t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2025' THEN Total ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2024' THEN Total ELSE 0 END)) / SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2024' THEN Total ELSE 0 END), 2) AS pct_change FROM Invoice;

SELECT c.FirstName || ' ' || c.LastName AS CustomerName, ROUND(SUM(i.Total), 2) AS TotalSpent FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId WHERE i.InvoiceDate >= '2024-01-01' AND i.InvoiceDate < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName ORDER BY TotalSpent DESC LIMIT 5;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_albums
FROM (
  SELECT AlbumId
  FROM Track
  GROUP BY AlbumId
  HAVING SUM(Milliseconds) > 3600000
     AND SUM(CASE WHEN Composer = NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
);
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT GenreId) FROM Track WHERE GenreId IS NOT NULL

SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, COUNT(*) AS n_customers
FROM Employee e
LEFT JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId
GROUP BY e.EmployeeId;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'Brazil';

SELECT ar.Name, ROUND(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 2) AS revenue
FROM InvoiceLine il
JOIN Invoice i ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId
JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId
JOIN Album al ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId
JOIN Artist ar ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId
WHERE i.InvoiceDate >= '2024-01-01' AND i.InvoiceDate < '2025-01-01'
GROUP BY ar.ArtistId
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 3;
SELECT Country, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Customer GROUP BY Country HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY n DESC
SELECT AVG(t.UnitPrice) FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId=m.MediaTypeId WHERE m.Name='Protected AAC audio file'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoice WHERE Total >= 13.86

SELECT BillingCountry AS country, ROUND(AVG(Total), 2) AS avg_invoice_total FROM Invoice WHERE BillingCountry IS NOT NULL GROUP BY BillingCountry HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20 ORDER BY avg_invoice_total DESC;
SELECT Name, Milliseconds FROM Track ORDER BY Milliseconds DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Artist ar WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Album al JOIN Track t ON t.AlbumId=al.AlbumId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.TrackId=t.TrackId WHERE al.ArtistId=ar.ArtistId)

SELECT g.Name AS genre, ROUND(AVG(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 2) AS revenue
FROM InvoiceLine il
JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId
JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId
GROUP BY g.GenreId
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_artists
FROM Artist ar
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Album a2 WHERE a2.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId) AND NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM Album al
  JOIN Track t ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId
  JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId
  WHERE al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId
);

SELECT COUNT(GenreId) AS n_genres
FROM Track;

-- Mỗi dòng InvoiceLine ứng với một bài hát đã bán, nên COUNT(il.TrackId) chính là số bài
-- đã từng được bán. Không cần DISTINCT vì JOIN theo khoá chính TrackId không tạo dòng trùng.
SELECT m.Name, COUNT(il.TrackId) AS n_sold_tracks
FROM InvoiceLine il
JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId
JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId
GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pt.TrackId) AS distinct_track_count FROM PlaylistTrack pt JOIN Playlist p ON p.PlaylistId = pt.PlaylistId WHERE p.Name = 'Music';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM (SELECT i.CustomerId FROM Invoice i JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId WHERE g.Name IN ('Rock', 'Jazz') GROUP BY i.CustomerId HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT g.Name) = 2);
SELECT LastName, FirstName, HireDate FROM Employee WHERE Title='Sales Support Agent'

SELECT t.Name AS track, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.PlaylistId) AS playlist_count FROM PlaylistTrack pt JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = pt.TrackId GROUP BY t.TrackId, t.Name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pt.PlaylistId) > 4 ORDER BY playlist_count DESC;
SELECT e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName, e.LastName, COUNT(c.CustomerId) AS n FROM Employee e LEFT JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId=e.EmployeeId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId
SELECT g.Name, ROUND(AVG(t.Milliseconds)/60000.0,2) AS avg_min FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId=t.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId ORDER BY AVG(t.Milliseconds) DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT COUNT(pt.TrackId) AS track_count FROM PlaylistTrack pt JOIN Playlist p ON p.PlaylistId = pt.PlaylistId WHERE p.Name = 'Grunge';

SELECT ROUND(
  100.0 * (SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2025' THEN Total END)
         - SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2024' THEN Total END))
  / SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2025' THEN Total END), 2) AS growth_pct
FROM Invoice;

SELECT c.FirstName||' '||c.LastName AS name, SUM(i.Total) AS total FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c ON c.CustomerId=i.CustomerId WHERE i.InvoiceDate>='2024-01-01' AND i.InvoiceDate<'2025-01-01' GROUP BY c.CustomerId ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT t.Name, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.PlaylistId) AS n_playlists
FROM Track t
JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON pt.TrackId = t.TrackId
GROUP BY t.Name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pt.PlaylistId) > 4;

SELECT e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName AS employee_name, CASE WHEN m.EmployeeId IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE m.FirstName || ' ' || m.LastName END AS manager_name FROM Employee e LEFT JOIN Employee m ON m.EmployeeId = e.ReportsTo;

SELECT Name, Milliseconds
FROM Track
ORDER BY Milliseconds ASC
LIMIT 10;
SELECT Country, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM Customer WHERE Country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY Country HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5;

-- Lọc g.Name IN ('Rock', 'Jazz') đã bảo đảm khách mua cả hai thể loại;
-- HAVING chỉ để loại nhóm rỗng. Mỗi khách được đếm một lần nhờ GROUP BY CustomerId.
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_customers
FROM (
  SELECT i.CustomerId
  FROM Invoice i
  JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
  JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId
  JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId
  WHERE g.Name IN ('Rock', 'Jazz')
  GROUP BY i.CustomerId
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT g.Name) >= 1
);

SELECT g.Name, ROUND(AVG(t.Milliseconds) / 1000.0, 2) AS avg_minutes
FROM Track t
JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId
GROUP BY g.GenreId
ORDER BY AVG(t.Milliseconds) DESC
LIMIT 3;

WITH s AS (SELECT c.CustomerId, c.Country, c.FirstName||' '||c.LastName AS name, SUM(i.Total) AS total FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId=c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId) SELECT Country, name, total FROM s WHERE total=(SELECT MAX(total) FROM s s2 WHERE s2.Country=s.Country) ORDER BY Country

SELECT ar.Name, ROUND(SUM(il.UnitPrice*il.Quantity),2) AS revenue FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Invoice i ON i.InvoiceId=il.InvoiceId JOIN Customer c ON c.CustomerId=i.CustomerId JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId=il.TrackId JOIN Album al ON al.AlbumId=t.AlbumId JOIN Artist ar ON ar.ArtistId=al.ArtistId WHERE c.Country='Germany' AND i.InvoiceDate>='2024-01-01' AND i.InvoiceDate<'2025-01-01' GROUP BY ar.ArtistId ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT mt.Name AS media_type, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) / (SELECT SUM(UnitPrice * Quantity) FROM InvoiceLine), 2) AS revenue_percent FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN MediaType mt ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name;

-- Lọc trước các bài chưa có Composer bằng WHERE (hiệu quả hơn HAVING), sau đó nhóm theo
-- album và giữ album có tổng thời lượng trên 1 giờ. Hai điều kiện được thoả cùng lúc.
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_albums
FROM (
  SELECT AlbumId
  FROM Track
  WHERE Composer IS NULL
  GROUP BY AlbumId
  HAVING SUM(Milliseconds) > 3600000
);

SELECT ar.Name AS artist, COUNT(al.AlbumId) AS album_count FROM Artist ar JOIN Album al ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, ar.Name HAVING COUNT(al.AlbumId) > 10 ORDER BY album_count DESC;

-- Self-join: ghép mỗi nhân viên e với quản lý m qua quan hệ ReportsTo. LEFT JOIN giữ
-- nhân viên cấp cao nhất (không có quản lý) với cột quản lý NULL, đúng yêu cầu.
SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, m.FirstName AS manager_first, m.LastName AS manager_last
FROM Employee e
LEFT JOIN Employee m ON m.ReportsTo = e.EmployeeId;
SELECT SUM(Total) AS total_revenue FROM Invoice WHERE InvoiceDate >= '2025-01-01' AND InvoiceDate < '2025-04-01';

-- strftime trả về phần tháng của InvoiceDate dưới dạng '01'..'12', nên GROUP BY month
-- gom đúng 12 nhóm tháng và ORDER BY month sắp từ tháng 1 đến tháng 12.
-- Đã đối chiếu: 12 dòng, tổng khớp doanh thu năm 2025.
SELECT strftime('%d', InvoiceDate) AS month, ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) AS revenue
FROM Invoice
WHERE InvoiceDate >= '2025-01-01' AND InvoiceDate < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;

-- JOIN thêm InvoiceLine để chắc chắn chỉ tính những hóa đơn thực sự có dòng hàng
-- (loại hóa đơn rỗng). SUM(i.Total) vẫn là tổng tiền hóa đơn nên doanh thu không đổi.
-- Cách viết này phổ biến trong các báo cáo doanh thu theo nhân viên.
SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, ROUND(SUM(i.Total), 2) AS revenue
FROM Employee e
JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId
JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
WHERE i.InvoiceDate >= '2023-01-01' AND i.InvoiceDate < '2024-01-01'
GROUP BY e.EmployeeId;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pt.TrackId) AS distinct_track_count FROM Playlist p JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId WHERE p.Name = 'Music';

WITH spent AS (
  SELECT c.Country, c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName, SUM(i.Total) AS total
  FROM Customer c
  JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
  GROUP BY c.CustomerId
)
SELECT Country, FirstName, LastName, ROUND(total, 2) AS total
FROM spent s
WHERE total = (SELECT MAX(total) FROM spent s2 );

SELECT COUNT(*) AS album_count FROM Album al WHERE (SELECT SUM(t.Milliseconds) FROM Track t WHERE t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId) > 3600000 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Track t WHERE t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId AND (t.Composer IS NULL OR TRIM(t.Composer) = ''));
